values.formattedValue: Graduating high school senior, Completed FVCC college application. To be eligible to apply for the FVCC Eagle Scholarship, students must have applied as a new incoming, degree-seeking student for the upcoming fall semester. Running Start students can be eligible if they have earned college credits and will now be a degree-seeking student in the upcoming fall semester. Students will be awarded based on their most recent cumulative GPA (either high school or college for transfer students), HiSET or GED Scores.

values.formattedValue: Eligible students: Senior girls in Flathead County Public High Schools in 2025 who are planning to attend college or university. Criteria: financial need, academic ability, and those seeking a career that aligns with the mission of Soroptimist International. Our mission statement is "A global volunteer organization that provides women and girls with access to the education and training they need to achieve economic empowerment." Priority given to girls planning to attend in-state programs (but it is NOT a requirement!).
